description: This file defines an Angular component called NotesLayoutComponent, which manages and displays notes using injected services and signals. It handles note creation, selection, deletion, and updates, and interacts with child components for sidebar, notes list, and note editor.

classes.name: NotesLayoutComponent
classes.description: Angular component managing a notes interface, including filtering, selection, and CRUD operations on notes.

methods.name: onCreateNote
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new note by invoking the NoteService.

methods.name: onSelectNote
methods.description: Selects a note by its ID using the NoteService.

methods.name: onDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID via the NoteService.

methods.name: onUpdateNote
methods.description: Updates a note's content by invoking the NoteService.

methods.name: noop
methods.description: A no-operation handler for filter change.
